No geometry repair, historical ownership or official statistical assertion. Raw computed area 1675963.6713476111 km2; 1 source features. pyproj 3.7.2; Shapely 2.1.2. qualifications: Derived mapped/geometric area, not an official contemporary historical area statistic.

Boundary snapshot year is the geometry observation date. No continuous territorial validity is inferred between snapshots.
